source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Models in this unit get +1 to their Toughness characteristic. This is one of the Temple Relics abilities: in your Command phase, if the unit still includes at least one Cenobyte Servitor model, you can pick it, and Chaplain Grimaldus then has it until your next Command phase starts.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
